parent_objective: design a sampling repair after M1415 fails before source materialization
blocked_by: M1415 source smoke produced zero rows due obstacle scenario sampling failure
supersedes: rerunning M1415 with the same over-constrained obstacle filter
treating M1415 no-rows as evidence against the retuned warmup gate

public_gates: M1416 must repair scenario sampling before another source smoke
M1416 must preserve the retuned warmup gate geometry unless explicitly justified
M1416 must not train, run PPO, run source smoke, run outcome interventions, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim self-identification from M1415 no-rows
do not rerun the same over-constrained obstacle filter

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a repaired source-smoke config after M1415 fails scenario sampling before warmup evidence can be tested
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no source smoke, outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if repair reruns the same over-constrained sampling filter
stop if repair removes warmup evidence diagnostics
stop if repair routes directly to outcome or training
stop if actor input changes are proposed
fallback_plan: admit repaired source smoke if obstacle sampling is relaxed without removing the warmup retarget
route to branch synthesis if a non-overfit repair is not credible
pivot away from staged gate if sampling cannot be repaired

admission_evidence: M1415 rejected rows are dominated by trace reconstruction and obstacle scenario sampling failures
M1415 did not test retuned warmup gate evidence
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one follow-up manifest if design admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1416 is design only after a no-row source failure and cannot claim history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: repair source materialization before history tests
preserve warmup diagnostics for later tests
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Record M1415 as scenario sampling failure, not as evidence against self-ID.
allowed_claims: no source smoke, outcome intervention, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: Relaxing the obstacle sampling filter while preserving the retuned warmup gate can repair M1415 source materialization without claim expansion.
success_criteria: design identifies the M1415 sampling failure
design specifies repaired obstacle and warmup gate parameters
design admits or rejects one repaired source smoke without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: repair reruns the same over-constrained obstacle filter
repair routes directly to outcome probing, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or claim expansion
decision_rule: M1416 passes if it designs a repaired source-smoke route that fixes sampling without training or claim expansion.
